citations.quote: Would activities that an RA 13 depositary performs in its capacity as a Transfer Agent (TA) (eg, processing payments in designated accounts) be subject to requirements under the CMR?

The CMR will apply to an RA 13 licensed corporation (LC) and its associated entity (AE) in respect of “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong by the RA 13 LC or its AE in the course of conducting Type 13 regulated activity by the RA 13 LC, regardless of the role played by such LC.

That said, in the context of RA 13, handling of money which is not “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong will not be subject to the CMR. In such cases, the depositary is expected to observe relevant requirements under Schedule 11 to the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Schedule 11), in particular paragraphs 9 (relating to how subscription and redemption proceeds should be held) and 11 (relating to distribution proceeds).
We do not intend to regulate SPVs as AEs of a REIT depositary for the purpose of the CMR.

readings.distinction: The candidate attachments are: role independence qualifying applicability as a whole, or qualifying the LC's conduct of Type 13 activity. Both preserve the same antecedent because neither makes a particular role necessary or disqualifying. A Transfer-Agent-only domain suggested by the question does not justify adding transfer_agent as a substantive condition to the answer's general wording. A Transfer Agent exception contradicts “regardless”, and disregarding money or location qualifications extends the phrase beyond its stated object. The following paragraph permits rival negation attachments, retained in questions, but those do not change the selected affirmative trigger. Only one distinct defensible predicate is retained; no substantive omitted rival to this trigger was identified.

vocabulary_concerns: ra13_context compresses actor identity, associated-entity status, handling and the connection to the LC's activity. Its supplied definition does not separately establish receipt or holding by the required actor.

Omitting transfer_agent faithfully makes this predicate independent of that input. The vocabulary nevertheless cannot separately describe other LC roles or AE roles; this limits richer role comparisons, not the encoded independence itself.

in_hong_kong is defined for scheme money, so it cannot independently locate non-scheme money. The rival negation attachments in the following paragraph cannot both be faithfully tested with these inputs.
There are no facts for Schedule 11 duties, their satisfaction or the modality of “is expected to observe”. A false applicability antecedent cannot serve as a complete Schedule 11 trigger.

Receipt dates, unknown-receipt status, contrary evidence, account ownership, REIT-property relationships and SPV status are absent. Q2 and Q3 qualifications must remain external; “Generally”, “In general” and “unlikely” cannot be silently converted into categorical Boolean rules.
The incorporated definitions and missing dependency have not been supplied. The fixed classifications remain assumptions requiring professional judgment, rather than independent legal authority.
